args.reason: The --dry-run DoD item serves the inspection goal, but two DoD items add capability outside every declared goal: a persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log appended on every evaluation, and an --explain timeline with --since and --format query options. The first PRD goal explicitly says historical storage and query features are outside this PRD. The Phase-1 reasoning that history is a natural extension of inspection ignores that exclusion. The DoD capability set is not a subset of the declared goals.
